description: yolov8m-seg (27M params) from COCO on merged v1+v2+v3 — hypothesis: smaller model generalize lучше on noisy small dataset
yolov8l-seg (46M params) from COCO on merged v1+v2+v3 — hypothesis: medium-large model is the sweet spot
yolov8x-seg (71M params) from v2-finetune weights on merged v1+v2+v3 — continuation of v2-finetune with v3 data
yolov8x-seg from v2-finetune, SGD lr=0.01 explicit (matches original v2-finetune recipe) — does SGD beat AdamW-auto on this dataset
yolov8l-seg from COCO with HIGHER lr — explore if smaller model + faster LR converges to better minimum
yolov8m-seg from COCO + imgsz=896 — higher resolution for small crowns (20-40px range moves to 28-56px)
yolov8s-seg (12M params) from COCO — continue size-down sweep, test if even smaller generalizes better
yolov8m-seg from COCO + dropout=0.15 — extra regularization для noisy polygon labels
yolov8m-seg from COCO + heavier aug (mixup=0.3, copy_paste=0.3) — opposite of run2's 'less aug', test if more diversity helps small dataset
yolov8m-seg chained — start from exp1's best.pt, continue with lr=0.0005 для gentle polish (continuation finetune)
3-stage continual learning: yolov8m-seg COCO→v1-only→v1+v2→v1+v2+v3 (paper #13 recipe)
Paper #7+#14: exp1 best.pt → fine-tune v3-only with lr=0.0001 patience=12 — aggressive low-LR finish
Paper #27 recipe: freeze=10 (backbone) for first 40 epochs at lr=0.001, then unfreeze + lr=0.0001 for 50 more
Paper #21 aug ranges proven on YOLOv8-v12 satellite trees: degrees=21, shear=15, hsv_v=0.44
Drop noisier v1 from train, keep v2+v3 only (48 imgs, 102 tiles vs 152 with v1). Quality > quantity?
Hybrid: train at imgsz=896 first 30 ep (more spatial detail), then continue at imgsz=640 for fine convergence
3-stage cumulative random chain (21→42→63 imgs, seed=42). Same LR schedule as exp11 but random splits — isolates chain mechanism from version drift.
2-stage random chain (31→63 imgs, seed=42). Stage 2 lr=0.001 (hot enough to actually learn). Mimics v2-finetune chain pattern with random splits — tests whether 2-stage + hot LR beats single-shot.
Single-shot exp1 config on random_phase1 (21 imgs / 50 tiles). Compares to exp17 stage 1.
Single-shot exp1 config on random_phase2 (42 imgs / 100 tiles). Compares to exp17 stages 1+2.
Single-shot exp1 config on random_phase3 (63 imgs / 152 tiles) = full merged. Sanity check: must give ~0.308.
Exact replicate of exp1 — same config, same data, same time budget (1.5h). Tests reproducibility of 0.308 result.
Third replicate of exp1 config. Variance estimation: prior 3 runs 0.308/0.268/0.269.
